question: HA#425 (nen/workflow.json monitor.localSlotFrees; HR-257 vs the 2026-10-13 stacked-PR rule): futon runs at most 7 local efforts at once. When does an effort's slot free?

options.label: merged (Recommended)
options.consequence: HR-257 for every run: a slot frees only at the local merge; the stacked rule is reconciled to it

options.label: stacked-open
options.consequence: A stacked effort frees its slot at PR-open; every other effort frees at ready+prompted

options.label: ready+prompted
options.consequence: Every effort frees once its PR is Ready and the merge prompt was shown
